name: FELM
description: FELM is a benchmark for evaluating the factuality of text generated by large language models across diverse domains including world knowledge, math, and reasoning. It includes fine-grained factuality labels, error types, and reference links to support or contradict statements.
reputation: A well-known benchmark for factuality evaluation of LLM outputs that is used in hallucination and verification research, though less standardized than some leaderboards.
notes: Focuses on fine-grained factuality evaluation with annotations at text segment level and predefined error types.
